newsitem.title: CHINA: Solartech places HK$285 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Solartech places HK$285 mln shares.

text.p: Cable maker and exporter Solartech International Holdings Ltd said on Friday its controlling shareholder had agreed to subscribe to 100 million new shares at HK$2.90 each, raising net proceeds of HK$285 million.

Solartech said its controlling shareholder Chau's Family 1996 Ltd, which is controlled by the company's chairman Chau Lai Him, had agreed to subscribe to the new shares after it placed 50 million existing shares to private investors at HK$2.90 each.
On completion of the deal on August 19, the shareholding of Chau's Family in Solartech will be diluted to 63.51 percent from 66.21 percent, it said.

The company said it would use the net proceeds raised to reduce bank loans, expand its sales network and manufacturing facilities in Shanghai and upgrade automated machinery for its plant in Dongguan.
It said the balance of the proceeds would be used to invest in components-making joint ventures and for working capital.
Solartech shares ended at HK$3.30 on Thursday.
